# `Q-23-3` — Book Has No References Chapter

> This book's chapters cite references, but no chapter can hold the
> bibliography, so the book has no reference list and its citations
> are not linked.

## What this means

An HTML book has one bibliography for the whole book. Quarto collects
the references every chapter cites and writes one merged list into the
book's references chapter. This book has citations, but no references
chapter, so the list has nowhere to go. The citations still render
("Knuth (1984)"), but they are not links, and no page lists the
references.

## Why this happens

The references chapter is the chapter `book.references` names. If that
key is not set, it is the first chapter that contains a div with the id
`refs`. This warning appears when neither exists: no `book.references`
key, and no chapter with a `#refs` div.

## How to fix

Add an empty `#refs` div to the chapter that should list the
references:

```markdown
# References {.unnumbered}

::: {#refs}
:::
```

Or name the chapter in `_quarto.yml`:

```yaml
book:
  chapters:
    - index.qmd
    - intro.qmd
  references: references.qmd
```
